correctness.rationale: The complete weights follow from an exact two-by-two Dirichlet-cardinal update. Cosecant strict convexity and reflection prove all nonmiddle weights positive; a decreasing denominator and increasing numerator give exactly one middle weight zero. Explicit Taylor expansions produce the N^-2 correction and finite-N quadratic divergence. The standalone checker actually passed 7820 numerical assertions and an independent small-N Fourier-Vandermonde solve corroborated the formulas. All quantifiers and excluded collision endpoint are stated; numerical checks are not relied on for infinite claims.

value.rationale: The positivity/noise frontier is an intrinsic sharp stability invariant for interpolatory periodic Fourier quadrature, not an ad hoc finite parameter. The smallest local three-site crowding mechanism differs qualitatively from adjacent-pair coalescence: one and only one negative middle weight develops at a universal nontrivial asymptotic fraction and the exact worst-case error amplifies quadratically. This gives a natural all-grid structural benchmark, including finite-resolution correction and exact collision coefficient, while making no unsupported broad convergence claim.
